de.speedbanking:iban-commons-bankdata 1.8.13 发布, Zero-dependency lookup of BIC and bank name master data (BLZ/Bankleitzahl/BC/kod
        banky/bank code directories) for a given IBAN or country-specific bank code. Ships a small
        bundled offline fallback dataset per country ("Urladung") and can refresh its data lazily
        and asynchronously from the respective national registry at runtime, persisting the result
        to a local cache directory. Initial country coverage: Germany (DE), Austria (AT),
        Switzerland (CH), Czech Republic (CZ), Belgium (BE), Poland (PL).

items.title:
de.speedbanking:iban-commons-de-checkdigit 1.8.13 发布, Zero-dependency implementation of the German banking industry's account number
        check digit methods ("Prüfzifferberechnungsmethoden in der deutschen Kreditwirtschaft"),
        as catalogued by the Deutsche Bundesbank. Validates whether a Kontonummer is
        structurally consistent for a given method, independently of any IBAN or BLZ
        master-data lookup. Deliberately standalone: does not depend on iban-commons,
        so it can be used on its own by callers that only have a BLZ and Kontonummer
        (e.g. legacy domestic payment processing) and have obtained the applicable
        method number from elsewhere (such as a BLZ master-data module).
